skill.name: pdf
skill.description: PDF toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating documents, merging or splitting files, and filling PDF forms with Python and command-line workflows.
skill.summary: Process, create, combine, analyze, and fill PDF documents with guided Python and command-line workflows.
skill.author: Cam10001110101

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by markdown code fences, inline backticks, f-strings, comments, or documentation URLs. The real security-relevant behavior is limited to helper scripts that write local PDF or JSON output files to user-supplied paths; no malicious intent, prompt injection, credential access, or outbound network behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to caller-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to write outputs into a working directory and avoid paths that could overwrite important files.

remediation.issue: Documentation includes command-line examples for decrypting or modifying PDFs.
remediation.suggestion: Add a short note that users should only decrypt, repair, or modify PDFs they are authorized to access.

remediation.issue: Generated form fields and annotations can contain sensitive personal data.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend deleting temporary field JSON files and rendered page images after completing sensitive forms.

content.value_statement: PDF work often requires many tools for extraction, form filling, and document assembly. This skill gives Claude practical workflows for processing PDFs with Python libraries and command-line utilities.
actual_capabilities: Extract text, tables, metadata, annotations, and images from PDF files.
Create new PDFs with text, tables, styling, and multiple pages.
Merge, split, rotate, crop, watermark, encrypt, decrypt, and optimize PDFs.
Fill AcroForm fields by extracting field IDs and validating values before writing output.
Fill non-interactive PDF forms with positioned text annotations after visual bounding-box validation.
Convert PDF pages to images for OCR, visual inspection, and form-layout analysis.
limitations: Scanned PDFs require OCR tools and may produce imperfect text results.
Form filling depends on accurate field detection or manual bounding-box validation.
Command-line examples require local tools such as qpdf, pdftotext, or pdfimages to be installed.
The scripts write local output files and can overwrite paths supplied by the user.

use_cases.title: Prepare completed forms
use_cases.description: Extract fillable fields, map user data to valid field IDs, and create a completed PDF copy.

use_cases.title: Extract structured document data
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, metadata, and annotations from reports for review or downstream analysis.

use_cases.title: Assemble document packets
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, watermark, crop, and encrypt PDFs for delivery-ready document bundles.

prompt_templates.title: Extract text from a PDF
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF skill to extract readable text from this PDF. Preserve page order and note any pages that appear scanned.

prompt_templates.title: Merge and organize PDFs
prompt_templates.prompt: Combine these PDF files into one document, keep the supplied order, and create a clear output filename.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF form
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the PDF form workflow to check whether this form has fillable fields, extract the fields, map my provided values, and produce a filled PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze and transform a PDF batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Process this folder of PDFs. Extract tables where present, split large files into logical sections, and create a summary of files that need OCR or manual review.

output_examples.input: Extract text and tables from a quarterly report PDF.
output: Extracted table data in a spreadsheet-friendly format.
Notes for pages where text extraction was incomplete.

output_examples.input: Fill a two-page application form with supplied applicant details.
output: A completed PDF saved as a new file.
A list of fields that were filled.
Warnings for fields that required visual verification.

output_examples.input: Merge three signed documents and add password protection.
output_examples.output: A single protected PDF package with the requested file order and encryption settings applied.

best_practices: Work on copies of important PDFs before merging, splitting, filling, or encrypting them.
Inspect generated PDFs visually after form filling, OCR, or coordinate-based annotation.
Use explicit output filenames in a working directory to avoid accidental overwrites.
anti_patterns: Do not run form-filling scripts before extracting and validating field IDs.
Do not trust OCR output without reviewing pages that contain scans or complex layouts.
Do not remove PDF passwords unless you have authorization to access the document.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports fillable AcroForm fields and non-fillable forms that need positioned text annotations.

faq.question: Can it process scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: Yes, with OCR tools such as pytesseract and pdf2image. OCR quality depends on scan clarity.

faq.question: Does it require external software?
faq.answer: Some workflows use Python packages. Command-line workflows may require tools such as qpdf, pdftotext, or pdfimages.

faq.question: Can it extract tables?
faq.answer: Yes. The guide uses pdfplumber and pandas patterns for extracting and combining tables.

faq.question: Will it upload PDFs to a service?
faq.answer: No evidence found of upload behavior in the inspected files. The included scripts operate on local files.

faq.question: What should I check before using it on sensitive documents?
faq.answer: Confirm local tool permissions, use copies, choose safe output paths, and review completed PDFs before sharing them.
